rows.Applicability / grouping: SOW-defined Staff; ALL applicable A–W topics. One parent assignment. Client-specific learning links to assignments.
rows.Timing and evidence: Due MIN(hire+30 calendar days, first solo service). Completion proves every required topic.
rows.UI / evaluation: My tasks: Complete orientation. No ANY-topic shortcut.

rows.Subject and facts: staff.hire_date; first_aid credential; CPR credential; person_centered completion
rows.Applicability / grouping: ALL(first aid, CPR, person-centered). Distinct credentials and expiry.
rows.Timing and evidence: Initial due hire+90 days; first aid/CPR current thereafter; no invented person-centered expiry.
rows.UI / evaluation: One onboarding group, separate renewable credential records.

rows.Subject and facts: active staff-client assignments; client.behavior_risk; certification; alternative approval
rows.Applicability / grouping: EXISTS assigned person likely aggressive/self-injurious/destructive AND ANY approved complete route.
rows.Timing and evidence: Hire+180 days; maintain certification. Newly arising assignment risks and elapsed hire deadline require review before scheduling.
rows.UI / evaluation: Assign only to affected staff; show why.

rows.Applicability / grouping: EXISTS assigned ABI client; ALL required ABI topics. General ABI orientation is a separate requirement.
rows.Timing and evidence: Before solo support for ABI person; no default annual expiry.
rows.UI / evaluation: Client assignment triggers matching staff task.

rows.Applicability / grouping: Employment years 2 onward; sum unique eligible classroom and documented on-job hours >=12 within each window.
rows.Timing and evidence: Employment anniversary anchored; no double counting one event through multiple requirement links.
rows.UI / evaluation: Progress bar e.g. 8 of 12 hours with next anniversary deadline.

rows.Subject and facts: agency.service_awards; staff.service_codes; supervisor links; ACRE evidence
rows.Applicability / grouping: Agency has >=1 ACRE staff AND every SEI staff has qualifying supervisor.
rows.Timing and evidence: Re-evaluate on hire, assignment, supervisor or evidence change.
rows.UI / evaluation: Agency coverage alert plus affected staff readiness.

rows.Subject and facts: staff provides SEI; course credential history
rows.Applicability / grouping: ANY(historical BEST, USU Workplace Supports, USU Effective Job Coach); independent from 30.6(b).
rows.Timing and evidence: Before SEI services. Verify named course evidence.
rows.UI / evaluation: One training task with approved alternative routes.

rows.Subject and facts: agency SEI award; benefits-qualified designated staff
rows.Applicability / grouping: COUNT(qualified staff)>=1; not every SEI or office staff.

rows.Subject and facts: agency SEI service start history; award date; approval and receipt
rows.Applicability / grouping: Before 2026-07-01 cohort vs award on/after date; retain distinct branches.
rows.Timing and evidence: 2027-01-31 existing cohort; award+6 months new cohort. Verify source email typo.
rows.UI / evaluation: Agency task with official proof submission.

rows.Subject and facts: staff provides CMP/CMS; official DSPD course result
rows.Applicability / grouping: service_code IN(CMP,CMS) AND score>=80. SLN alone does not trigger.
rows.Timing and evidence: Official New Caregiver Compensation course; effective 2026-07-01.
rows.UI / evaluation: External course button and verified proof.

rows.Subject and facts: hire date; ACRE; qualified supervisor; performs Discovery
rows.Applicability / grouping: ACRE new hire within60 days with qualified supervision pending; Customized Employment training if Discovery.
rows.Timing and evidence: Do not copy SEI alternatives to SJD. Verify source SJB typo in 33.5(a).
rows.UI / evaluation: Separate SJD pathway with conditional Discovery training.

rows.Applicability / grouping: Default quarterly; monthly substitutes for CMP/CMS/PN1/PN2/SEI/SJD; PBA financial substitute; BC additional content.
rows.Timing and evidence: General quarterly due15 calendar days after quarter; code-specific monthly deadline/destination overrides.
rows.UI / evaluation: One applicable report, not duplicate monthly and quarterly tasks.

rows.Subject and facts: service code; unit type; service date; staff/client; applicable source elements
rows.Applicability / grouping: General note schema unless explicit service-specific override. Form fields ALL unless source conditional.
rows.Timing and evidence: Use full raw source fields; preserve independent EVV, payroll/timesheet, signatures and reporting requirements.
rows.UI / evaluation: Code-specific note form with missing-field validation.

rows.Subject and facts: code; waiver; unit type; service setting; verified Medicaid mapping
rows.Applicability / grouping: SOW family mapping is not enough to certify every billing-code/unit scenario. Verify external EVV matrix.
rows.Timing and evidence: Local PI capture reported in uploaded file is not proof of required state integration or acceptance.
rows.UI / evaluation: Until verified, show EVV mapping review; no invented integration success.

rows.Subject and facts: client/service date; authorization; hospitalization; incarceration; overlapping services; exception approvals
rows.Applicability / grouping: Apply all general restrictions with exact service-specific exceptions. Any overlap is not automatically prohibited.
rows.Timing and evidence: Evaluate actual date/time and unit; preserve admission/discharge and incoming/outgoing provider distinctions.

rows.Subject and facts: client payee role; ledger; reviewer; transactions; reporting period
rows.Applicability / grouping: Distinct monthly person review, monthly administrator review and quarterly third-person sample; reviewers differ as source specifies.
rows.Timing and evidence: Link itemized financial evidence, statements and distribution receipts. Do not satisfy all with one generic attestation.
rows.UI / evaluation: PBA workspace with scheduled reviews and ledger-backed reports.

rows.Applicability / grouping: Past fixed deadline does not mean retired; determine if requirement applied and evidence exists.
rows.UI / evaluation: Historical overdue/needs review rather than silently compliant.
